resources.string: Some launchers take a moment (or a trip back to the home screen) to show the new icon.
Use all shortcut slots in Direct mode
No slot reserved for Configure — long-press shows only your items. A translucent gear flashes on launch instead.
One shortcut slot is reserved for a permanent Configure entry
Adds a separate icon that launches it directly, next to Not App
Configure your first item to enable this

To flash a Configure gear over the app it launches — instead of holding you on a blank screen or reserving a shortcut slot — Not App needs the \"draw over other apps\" permission. You\'ll be taken to system settings to turn it on.
